india_trends.title: Why reducing govt debt matters for India even when it’s lower than advanced economies
india_trends.summary: India's high interest-to-revenue burden and strict market expectations for emerging economies make reducing public debt essential to safeguard investor trust even as India runs lower debt levels compared to advanced economies.

india_trends.summary: Oriflame India sold its manufacturing operations in India to local company Akum Pharmaceuticals two months back, a move many industry executives interpreted as the Swedish player winding down its exposure in India. Campbell said the deal was to spur growth.
